name: 镇江阁地标周边片区
coverageNote: 以镇江阁为中心，选取与 320 米核心范围相交的源要素；道路、水体和地表在半幅 400 米矩形缓冲框内裁剪。保留全部符合范围的原始建筑轮廓，不覆盖全城。

heightPolicy.tag: Source height in metres; supplied height is not independently surveyed or verified.
heightPolicy.levels: Source num_floors multiplied by an estimated 3 metres per floor.
heightPolicy.default: Fixed 12 metre visualization height, not a measured or predicted building height.
heightPolicy.globfp2020: 2020 remote-sensing height prediction from 3D-GloBFP v3, accepted only after strict bidirectional footprint overlap; rounded to 0.1 m for display, not a surveyed height or accuracy claim.

buildings.heightNote: 本片区 54 栋公开建筑轮廓中，44 栋使用 12 米参考高度，10 栋匹配 2020 年遥感估算楼高；均不代表新增实测。

attribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors; © Overture Maps Foundation. East Asian building footprints: Qian Shi et al., DOI:10.5281/zenodo.8174931, CC BY 4.0. Height estimates: Yangzi Che et al., 3D-GloBFP v3 (2020), DOI:10.5281/zenodo.15459025, CC BY 4.0; spatially matched and rounded.
renderingNote: 仅从保留源数据空间筛选；源要素 ID、properties、建筑高度与全部入选建筑轮廓保持原样。裁剪边界不能作为岸线。
